_note: Owner decision (docs/14 D25): English terms stay in Latin script in the TTS text so Gemini pronounces them as English; everything else is Persian. The hook prompt asks for Latin terms; this list is the safety net that turns Persian-script transliterations back into Latin. Applied to TTS text only (never on-screen text). Whole-word, longest match first. The voice stage strips kasre/fathe marks and treats ZWNJ/space as equal before matching.
